goals: Verify the data return behavior of ALP under various forwarding configurations (direct/indirect) and break query conditions
Verify the capability of a node performing a continuous scan to receive FEC encoded messages larger than 255 bytes
activities: Set up a default access class
Set up an alternative access class

Create a file on the requester containing scenario-specific configuration or predefined bytes

Start a session on the requester for the configured command
Verify whether the responder receives an unsolicited response
